summary: NIO Inc. furnished on Form 6-K its September 1, 2026 HK interim report for the six months ended June 30, 2026, including a supplemental reconciliation of material differences between U.S. GAAP and IFRS. The filing is purely a routine financial reporting disclosure to satisfy Hong Kong Listing Rules, with no special-situation elements such as M&A, tender offers, buybacks, or strategic actions. The company is not a target, acquirer, or seller in any transaction. The reconciliation covers share-based compensation, convertible notes, capped calls, redeemable non-controlling interests, leases, and other accounting adjustments. No deal terms, advisory roles, or value implications exist; expect no market-moving corporate activity from this routine filing.
